 GTA 6 PS5 and Xbox crashes are losing hours of progress, despite autosave system
 ⓘ Rockstar Games, Canva AI Banner for GTA 6 autosave system is shown Because of vanishing files, some GTA 6 PS5 and Xbox players are stuck in a mission loop. Rockstar’s autosave safeguard isn't proving reliable when consoles freeze or reboot. Manual saves can avoid repeating the same tasks around the Leonida open-world map. Adam Corsetti , Published 11/19/2026 Console Gaming Fail Microsoft 
 4 Reviews     ← exclude selected types     ← exclude selected tags 
 For most players who unlocked the game first , the GTA 6 release date has gone smoothly. Still, crashes on PS5 and Xbox consoles have required unlucky gamers to replay missions . Adding to the issue is confusion over the autosave system, which may not behave as expected. 
 The problem gained attention after popular streamer JasonTheWeen lost 10 hours of progress . It’s unclear whether his PS5 crashed or the content creator accidentally switched it off. Regardless, following a reboot, he could not locate a save file. The sudden power loss may have caused corruption.
 JasonTheWeen critics believe the ordeal was staged to attract attention. Even so, Reddit threads also document the GTA 6 Xbox Series X version failing at critical moments. FearlessHuckleberry6 had to restart the prologue multiple times. Meanwhile, during roughly 12 hours of gameplay on the release date, BielzBielz’s console crashed repeatedly. 
 What's causing the reboots?
 One explanation is that the demanding Rockstar title is overstressing the hardware . Autosaves should serve as a safeguard, but they often are not reliable. The studio hasn’t confirmed how frequently they generate backups. Since the prologue and certain mission checkpoints don’t trigger the system, manually saving is a wise precaution. 
 Gamers may also not realize the save game menu doesn’t display autosaves. When a crash strikes, they must access the separate load game interface to restore their progress. 
 The struggles of GTA 6 PS5 and Xbox players have reminded fans of similar Red Dead Redemption 2 shortcomings. PC users suffered the most, prompting Rockstar to push out a series of patches. Eventually, the feature became stable after explorers had to retread the same parts of the open-world map . 
 Like Red Dead Redemption 2 , GTA 6 demands an enormous time commitment. The main Jason and Lucia story takes around 50-60 hours , but Leonida is full of side activities and potential distractions. That makes having a dependable way to save progress or cloud backups even more important.
